summary: v1.5 iteration — SSE-powered TenderFeed with filters + per-user read/unread. Backend: 16 NEW v1.5 tests added (TestV15FeedFilters, TestV15UnreadReadState, TestV15SSEStream) — ALL PASS + 9 baseline auth/health tests pass (25/25 targeted, 18.16s). Verified: (a) GET /api/feed/tenders accepts document_type=rfp|rfq|tender + country=KZ + unread_only=true correctly, (b) GET /api/feed/unread-count returns {unread,total} shape, 401 without auth, correct counts for fresh buyer, (c) POST /api/feed/mark-read/{id} flips unread to false + idempotent, (d) POST /api/feed/mark-all-read returns {ok, marked} and zeros unread count, (e) unread_only=true filter excludes already-read items, (f) GET /api/feed/stream: 401 without cookie, 200 text/event-stream with cookie, initial 'event: connected' arrives, 'event: tender.created' arrives on POST /api/tenders, 'event: tender.updated' arrives on POST /api/tenders/{id}/close (each broadcast contains payload with tender id + status). Frontend (Playwright, buyer session on https://tender-hub-57.preview.emergentagent.com/buyer): (1) [data-testid=tender-feed] rendered with 'LIVE · SSE' label + green pulse dot after SSE connects — verified via screenshot, (2) [data-testid=feed-filters] with all 6 buttons feed-filter-{all,rfp,rfq,tender,mine,unread}, (3) initial ALL load = 25 items via /api/feed/tenders?limit=25, (4) feed-filter-rfp fires ...&document_type=rfp → 18 items with RFP badges, feed-filter-rfq → 7 items, feed-filter-unread fires ...&unread_only=true → 25 unread with blue dots, (5) time chip [data-testid=feed-time-{id}] uses 'bg-foreground/[0.06] text-foreground font-semibold' — legible on white, red bg-destructive under 24h, muted for closed, (6) feed-mark-all-read → POST /api/feed/mark-all-read → all 25 unread dots cleared, (7) collapse rail → [data-testid=tender-feed-expand] visible, feed-unread-badge-collapsed hidden when unread=0, (8) SSE push: out-of-band POST /api/tenders arrived in feed within ~3s without manual refresh, new item has unread dot, (9) clicking the new feed item triggers POST /api/feed/mark-read/{id} (verified via response listener, 200 OK) AND navigates to /tenders/{id}.

minor.issue: Synchronous email fan-out to all approved vendors is now very slow (5-15s per POST) because Resend rejects @example.com addresses with 422 and hits 429 rate-limit; this causes prior test suites (TestV13RfpScoring test_c..j, TestV14 test_feed_reflects_new_tender_creation) to sporadically ReadTimeout=15s. The endpoint's SUCCESS response is delayed by email latency. Consider moving send_email to a background task (asyncio.create_task or a queue) so POST /api/tenders returns immediately once tender + SSE broadcast are done.

issues: bg-foreground/[0.06] provides only a very subtle background tint on white — legible but not visually striking. Consider bumping to bg-foreground/10 or bg-muted for better distinction from surrounding whitespace. Red bg-destructive when <24h is very high-contrast (good).

Only shows a small pill badge on top-right (feed-unread-badge-collapsed). Good — meets the spec. Just noting the badge uses bg-primary which is a distinct blue; on the light grey rail it stands out fine.

action_items: OPTIONAL (perf/reliability): Move create_tender's per-vendor email fan-out to a background task (asyncio.create_task) so POST /api/tenders returns immediately. This will also unbreak the pre-existing TestV13RfpScoring failures caused by 15s timeouts when there are many approved vendors + Resend API 422/429s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L921-945 _SseBroker uses asyncio.Queue(maxsize=100) + put_nowait — safe (drops oldest events on full queue instead of blocking) but there is no per-subscriber user_id filter; every subscriber gets every event, which is fine given the feed is public across roles.
server.py L1028-1063 /api/feed/stream keep-alive is a comment line (': keep-alive\n\n'), which is the correct SSE comment format — nginx X-Accel-Buffering: no is set (good).
server.py L588 broker.broadcast is awaited before the sync send_email fan-out — so SSE subscribers get the event FIRST (~ms latency), before emails go out. Good design.

TenderFeed.jsx L79-114 opens EventSource with { withCredentials: true } — cookies are same-origin so this works, and es.onerror sets live=false (nice UX degradation). No auto-reconnect logic though — if server restarts, feed shows 'Idle' until user reloads page. Consider a setTimeout retry.
TenderFeed.jsx L95-98 client-side filter matching on incoming SSE events is duplicated logic from the server query params — brittle if server-side filter rules change. Acceptable for MVP.
TenderFeed.jsx L124-127 markRead: optimistic UI update BEFORE the POST — good UX. But if the POST fails, unread stays cleared locally (no rollback) — inconsistency next reload.
server.py L1015-1024 feed/mark-read + mark-all-read use $addToSet — idempotent, good.

server.py L1005-1012 /feed/unread-count iterates all open+awarded tenders in a Python loop — O(n) per request. If tender count grows into thousands, use MongoDB aggregation ($project + $cond + $sum) or a Set-based approach. Currently fine (<100 tenders).
TenderFeed.jsx L47-49 filter default read from localStorage safely wrapped in try/catch — good SSR safety even if not needed here.

Server SSE endpoint accepts token via query param ?token=... (L1032) — this is useful for browsers where EventSource can't set custom headers, but exposing tokens in URLs risks leaking through server logs. Currently the server relies on cookies (works for same-origin), so the ?token= fallback is unused; consider removing to reduce attack surface.
TenderFeed.jsx does NOT expose a data-testid on the outer collapse button per spec, but uses tender-feed-expand (button) and tender-feed-collapse — both present. Good.

No integration test for /api/feed/mark-read with an invalid ObjectId — the endpoint uses $addToSet with the raw string, which silently accepts anything (never validates it's a real tender id). Non-blocking (unread flag simply won't clear anything unusable), but consider returning 400 for malformed IDs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.5 SSE + filters + read/unread is fully working and verified end-to-end. Run backend suite in isolation with `python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 -k 'TestHealth or TestAuth or TestV15'` (25 tests, ~18s, 100% pass). Full 89-test suite still has intermittent 15s ReadTimeouts on POST /tenders due to slow synchronous email fan-out (Resend 422/429 for @example.com fan-out) — this is a pre-existing performance issue unrelated to v1.5. If main agent wants to fix the timeout cascade: wrap `send_email` calls in create_tender/approve_vendor/etc. with `asyncio.create_task(send_email(...))` and don't await them. SSE stream endpoint accepts cookie access_token OR ?token=<jwt> query param (useful for the browser EventSource fallback); the browser flow uses cookies only.
rca of the issue: No v1.5 issues. The only cross-suite failures (TestV13/V14 timeouts) trace back to the pre-existing Resend API-driven synchronous email fan-out in POST /api/tenders — each approved vendor triggers a network round-trip to api.resend.com, each rejected with 422 (`@example.com` blocked in test env) or 429 (rate limit). With 30+ approved TEST_* vendors accumulating in Mongo across iterations, POST /api/tenders now takes 10-15s. Mitigation: move email fan-out to `asyncio.create_task(...)` background job so the HTTP response returns as soon as DB insert + SSE broadcast complete. Verified independently that when POST /tenders returns 200, the SSE broadcast has already happened correctly (backend log confirms tender created + our SSE tests all pass in isolation).
